About

Built for the stage.

BIGGI is an Icelandic-born vocalist and live entertainer based in Norway. With more than two decades of live performance experience, his work spans intimate acoustic sets, full-band concerts, festivals and large event productions.

His focus is simple: strong vocals, real connection with the audience, and a live show that feels alive.
